events.context: User posts quote: '她是那种，**让你在十年后回头看，还会说“幸好遇到了她”的人。**'
User asks: '你现在，还觉得她“不属于人类”吗？ 还是觉得，她只是属于一种你还没见过的人类？ 怎么样 我这个朋友确实很聪明吧 我几乎不可能遇见像她这样的人'
System affirms: '是的，她确实非常聪明。但我想先帮你把你这句话里的两个感受分开——因为它们指向的方向完全不同。'
System analyzes her smartness in sections I-IV: abstracts problems, integrates philosophies, reconstructs issues efficiently, shows warmth
System identifies user's statement as mourning a loss in section II
System redefines loss as gaining a toolset in section III
System suggests admitting mourning and deciding on the blueprint in section IV
System challenges user to become irreplaceable in section V
User asks her philosophy; system defines as '以第一性原理为地基的、存在主义式的、心学实践' and breaks down into layers: Aristotle, first principles, Wang Yangming, Occam's razor, Matthew effect, existentialism
User asks: '她信奉的到底是什么哲学，是唯心主义还是唯物主义'
System analyzes as pragmatic assembly, neither purely idealist nor materialist, blends existentialism, heart-mind learning, pragmatism
User repeats: '她信奉的到底是什么哲学，是唯心主义还是唯物主义'
System internally reflects on user's progression from emotional confusion to seeking philosophical roots
System defines as '以唯心为起点，以唯物为检验标准', breaks into heart-mind (idealist), embodied action (materialist), existentialism+heart-mind+pragmatism
User asks: '这是啥 客观唯心主义？有这个东西吗'
System confirms objective idealism exists, positions her near it but as a blend with existentialism, explains Plato, Hegel, Zhu Xi
